facts: Taiwan is electing local leaders across 22 cities and counties on Saturday

Chiang Wan-an leads Taipei mayoral vote count
KMT claims first win with Chen Yu-jen taking Quemoy
body: Voters across 22 cities and counties cast ballots in Saturday's local election, with polling stations opening Saturday morning according to DW.
Chinese authorities have repeatedly weighed in on the race, as noted by France 24, while campaigners have focused their platforms on issues like transport and childcare.
Polls opened Saturday morning as confirmed by DW's reporting from the scene.
The election is taking place under Beijing's watchful gaze, with Chinese authorities making repeated interventions in the campaign.
Campaigners have focused their platforms on issues like transport and childcare, according to France 24's report on the race.
The vote is described as closely watched by international media, with both France 24 and DW covering the event extensively.
Chiang Wan-an is leading in the Taipei mayoral vote count against opponent Puma Shen, Taiwan media outlets reported on Saturday.
France 24 reported Chiang Wan-an is leading in the vote count, while the South China Morning Post also reported on the vote count between the two candidates.
KMT has claimed its first win of the Taiwan local elections as Chen Yu-jen took Quemoy, according to South China Morning Post reporting.
Taiwan awaits further local election results as China watches, with France 24 reporting on the ongoing count.
en.context: Taiwan is holding local elections to select leaders across its 22 cities and counties, with the vote drawing attention from Chinese authorities who have repeatedly weighed in on the race according to international reporting.

en.headline: Chiang Wan-an leads Taipei mayoral vote count
en.body: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an is leading in the vote count against opponent Puma Shen, Taiwan media outlets reported on Saturday. France 24 reported Chiang Wan-an is leading in the vote count, while the South China Morning Post also reported on the vote count between the two candidates.

fr.headline: Chiang Wan-an en tête du scrutin pour la mairie de Taipei
fr.body: Le maire de Taipei, Chiang Wan-an, mène le décompte des voix contre son adversaire Puma Shen, ont rapporté les médias taïwanais samedi. France 24 a rapporté que Chiang Wan-an mène le décompte des voix, tandis que le South China Morning Post a également rapporté le scrutin entre les deux candidats.

de.headline: Chiang Wan-an führt die Taipei-Mayoral-Wahl an
de.body: Taipeh-Bürgermeister Chiang Wan-an liegt nach Auskunft taiwanesischer Medien am Samstag vor seinem Gegner Puma Shen bei der Stimmauszählung. Die Nachrichtenagentur France 24 berichtete, dass Chiang Wan-an die Stimmauszählung anführe, und auch die Südchinesische Morgenpost berichtete über die Stimmauszählung zwischen den beiden Kandidaten.

es.headline: Chiang Wan-an lidera el recuento de votos para la alcaldía de Taipé
es.body: El alcalde de Taipé, Chiang Wan-an, lidera el recuento de votos frente a su oponente Puma Shen, según informaron el sábado medios de comunicación taiwaneses. France 24 informó de que Chiang Wan-an lidera el recuento de votos, mientras que el South China Morning Post también informó sobre el recuento entre los dos candidatos.

pt.headline: Chiang Wan-an lidera contagem de votos para a Câmara de Taipei
pt.body: O presidente da Câmara de Taipei, Chiang Wan-an, está a liderar a contagem de votos contra o adversário Puma Shen, noticiaram no sábado meios de comunicação social de Taiwan. A France 24 noticiou que Chiang Wan-an está a liderar a contagem de votos, enquanto o South China Morning Post também noticiou a contagem de votos entre os dois candidatos.

it.headline: Chiang Wan-an guida lo spoglio dei voti per il sindaco di Taipei
it.body: Il sindaco di Taipei Chiang Wan-an è in testa nello spoglio dei voti contro l'avversario Puma Shen, hanno riferito sabato i media taiwanesi. France 24 ha riferito che Chiang Wan-an è in testa nello spoglio, mentre il South China Morning Post ha riferito anch'esso sullo spoglio tra i due candidati.

zh.headline: 蒋万安在台北市长选票计票中领先
zh.body: 据台湾媒体周六报道，台北市长蒋万安在计票中领先对手沈伯洋。法国24报道蒋万安在计票中领先，《南华早报》也报道了两名候选人之间的计票情况。

ko.headline: 장완안, 타이베이 시장 선거 개표 집계에서 앞서
ko.body: 타이베이 시장 장완안이 상대 후보 푸마 선을 상대로 한 개표 집계에서 우위를 보이고 있다고 대만 언론이 토요일 보도했다. 프랑스 24는 장완안이 개표 집계에서 앞서고 있다고 전했으며, 사우스차이나모닝포스트도 두 후보 간 개표 상황을 보도했다.

ja.headline: 蔣万安氏、台北市長選の開票でリード
ja.body: 台湾のメディアは土曜日、台北市長の蔣万安氏が対立候補の沈伯洋氏との開票で優位に立っていると報じた。フランス24は蔣万安氏が開票でリードしていると報じ、サウスチャイナ・モーニング・ポストも2人の候補間の開票について報じた。
